name: PM-KISAN (Samman Nidhi)
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year direct bank transfer in 3 equal instalments of Rs 2,000.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families across India (subject to exclusion criteria).
howToApply: Apply at pmkisan.gov.in, your nearest CSC (Common Service Centre), or local agriculture office with Aadhaar & land records.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Low-premium crop insurance covering natural calamities, pests, and post-harvest losses (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi).
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops.
howToApply: Enroll via your bank branch, CSC, or pmfby.gov.in before seasonal cut-off dates.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing report every 2 years with crop-wise fertilizer and nutrient recommendations.
eligibility: All farmers; soil samples collected by state agriculture departments / KVKs.
howToApply: Contact your Gram Panchayat, local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), or visit soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Short-term crop and farm loans at subsidized 4% effective interest rate on timely repayment.
eligibility: Small/marginal farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and animal husbandry/fishery farmers.
howToApply: Apply at any Cooperative, Regional Rural, or Public Sector bank branch with Aadhaar, PAN, and land/lease proof.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
benefit: Transparent online mandi bidding and direct bank payment for farm produce across APMC mandis.
eligibility: Any farmer selling produce at an e-NAM linked mandi.
howToApply: Register free at the mandi gate or enam.gov.in with Aadhaar, bank passbook, and mobile number.
